name: rpg-factory
description: Development workflow orchestration for the UnityIndie RPG MMO workspace (server, client, Netcode, UnityDots, UIToolkit): Factory Core plus 8 specialised skills, deterministic skill routing, module registry with cross-repo contracts and facts, a check runner with graded evidence, derived cross-repo status for resuming work, and a git guard (Bash + PowerShell) with a tripwire. Agents never tag.
